definitions.latin: cométa, cométes, æ; m. = GREEK , ov; m. long-haired

quotations.english: the wise-minded call a comet by name

source_text: cométa, an; m. A comet; cométa, cométes, æ; m. = GREEK , ov; m. long-haired :-- Higegleáwe hátaþ cométa be naman the wise-minded call a comet by name, Chr. 975; Th. 228, 38, col. 1, 2, 3; Edg. 52.
